property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(10), SetLogFile(some address), and Initialized(), the reference contract marks intitalized as true so that SetMinSum cannot be called again; the modified version never sets intitalized, allowing SetMinSum(20) a second time, which changes MinSum from 10 to 20; the assertion asserts that the second SetMinSum reverts, which holds in the reference but fails in the modified version (the call does not revert).
